description: Letharene wears a full-length muted burgundy gown with a low square neckline, fitted bodice, elbow-length sleeves and narrow gold-brown woven trim. Geometric borders decorate the neck, sleeves, waist and long center-front panel. A cream shoulder wrap with patterned gold borders and fringed ends rests around the arms. Small round brooches fix the shoulder straps, and small earrings provide restrained jewelry. A narrow waist girdle is decorated with matching geometric trim. The low skirt opening reveals part of one brown closed flat shoe. Substantial opaque fabrics appear linen-like or softly woven, but exact fibers are uncertain. No headgear, armor or weapon appears.
